findings.title: An email, link or code that will scramble
findings.message: "TX-48213" sits in right-to-left text without isolation, so part of it can move.
findings.fix: Wrap it in <bdi>, or give its element dir="ltr".
findings.snippet:
مرحباً، سأساعدك. يرجى تزويدي رقم الطلب TX-48213.
10:16

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: Arabic falls back from Arial, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: Arabic lines set too tight
findings.message: Line height is 1.40 on "أود تفعيل خدمة 5G على بطاقة eSIM الخاصة …".
findings.fix: Give Arabic body text a line height of about 1.6 to 1.8, for example :lang(ar) { line-height: 1.7 }.
findings.snippet:
أود تفعيل خدمة 5G على بطاقة eSIM الخاصة بي.
10:15

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: border-bottom-left-radius: 15px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
findings.snippet:
أود تفعيل خدمة 5G على بطاقة eSIM الخاصة بي.
10:15
